p1_findings.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends request with crafted X-Forwarded-For header using IPv4-mapped IPv6 notation; express trusts forged IP, bypassing IP-allowlist or IP-based rate limiting
p1_findings.impact: Authentication/access-control bypass for any IP-restricted route

p1_findings.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read & Execution
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: When Vitest UI server is running (vitest --ui), attacker on same network sends path-traversal request to read arbitrary files or execute code with process privileges
p1_findings.impact: Full filesystem read and potential code execution in dev/CI environments

p1_findings.title: body-parser Denial of Service via Compressed Request
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker sends POST with valid gzip body followed by trailing bytes; body-parser throws uncaught exception, crashing the express process
p1_findings.impact: Complete denial of service to all API routes — no authentication required

p1_findings.title: @vitest/mocker Code Injection via Manual Mock Registration
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: During test execution, unauthenticated manual mock registration allows injected code path to be executed in test runner context
p1_findings.impact: Code execution in test/CI environment; potential credential exfiltration

p1_findings.title: Specifications/ Describes Unimplemented Product (FR-001–FR-069 at 0% coverage)
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Any agent reads CLAUDE.md, opens Specifications/, and builds against FR-001–FR-069 instead of the actual implemented product spec; causes regressions or wasted sprint cycles
p1_findings.impact: Agents systematically misled about product domain; every new coder agent risks building the wrong thing
p1_findings.fix: Move dev-workflow-platform.md to docs/archive/ with header; add Specifications/README.md clarifying workflow-engine.md is the active spec

p1_findings.title: GET /api/search Not Wired — FR-dependency-search Unimplemented, Tests Fail
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: CI runs Source/Backend/tests/routes/search.test.ts; all tests fail because route is not registered. DependencyPicker component makes calls to /api/search and receives 404s in production
p1_findings.impact: CI test suite fails; DependencyPicker feature is broken in production
p1_findings.fix: Implement Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts with cross-entity search and register as app.use('/api', searchRouter) in app.ts
